data.narrative:
True Anomaly is a Defense & Security frontier-tech company at SPAC stage with a current valuation of $2.2B and total capital raised exceeding $1B. The peer universe comprises 16 same-sector companies at similar valuation tiers, including 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers. Top private comparables include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems, with valuations ranging from $1.0B to $9.2B.

Peer-median valuation analysis—the primary applicable method given available data—identifies a $2.3B median across the 16-company peer set. Sample peers include Saronic at $9.2B (Series D), Quantum-Systems at $8.0B (Series C), Flock Safety at $7.5B (Series G), Chaos Industries at $4.5B (Series D), and Skydio at $4.4B (Series F). This wide peer range reflects heterogeneity within Defense & Security across development stage and market application.

The triangulated valuation range is $2.0B to $2.7B (25th to 75th percentile around the $2.3B median). True Anomaly's current $2.2B valuation falls near the median and within this band, suggesting fair-value positioning relative to peer multiples. Key uncertainties include the binary outcomes typical of frontier-defense ventures and execution risk around commercialization timetables. The single-method reliance also limits confidence; additional revenue or margin multiples would strengthen conviction.
